method: Direct inspection of native, 4x nearest and key-pose contact sheets. Hero full front/back 16-frame sheets also inspected.
limitations: Contact-sheet review verifies the listed views, readable silhouettes, faces and cropping; it is not an exhaustive frame-by-frame anatomical audit or physical exercise demonstration validation. Sources are generated illustrations, processed into native PNGs without facial painting or palette reduction.
